title: Chrome Trigger
idea: Cyberpunk novel based on the Data Riot album Chrome Trigger. Night City, a neon megacity of cyber-arms, spinal ports, holo-tables and retinal-scan contracts. The Ronin, a masterless mercenary crew that answers to the highest bidder, take the Alpha Contract: a faceless client with a voice like grinding stone offers too many zeros to count for a package inside the Spire, the most guarded tower in the city. The spoken contract waives the contractor's right to life. The job goes loud in the Sector Seven market, civilians die, a target is hunted through the neon jungle, and a gutter king warns them off his turf. The crew stacks creds and briefly believes it has won. Then the client is revealed as Mr. Johnson, a tower executive who hired them to erase a rival and planned the crew's own erasure as the final line item. One crew member drowns in digital dopamine, a neural euphoria addiction. In the aftermath the Night City Vultures, a chop-shop scavenger gang born in the ash of friendly fire, strip the dead Ronin for parts. Recurring motifs: Masterless, fearless, ronin. Sold, we don't ask why. Waste not, want not. Leave the meat for the rats. Receipt printed, no refunds. Trap armed. Tone: hard-boiled, kinetic, darkly comic, with a dancehall cadence in the dialogue. Theme: loyalty as a commodity, the body as hardware, the price of every payout.
